questions.missing: Representation of the emergency action instruction for passengers (the action to take in an emergency).
questions.why: The requirement (IMO-078 clause 8.3.3.3.3.6-.7) explicitly states that passengers shall be instructed in the use of personal survival equipment **and the action to take in an emergency**. The current SHACL model only validates the boolean property nltl:personalSurvivalEquipmentInstructionCompleted. No property or constraint captures the “emergency action” aspect.

resolved_evidence.text: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#passenger> <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#evidenceExcerpt> "Passengers shall be instructed in the use of the personal survival equipment and the action to take in an emergency; and the crew shall be trained in the use of the personal survival equipment and group survival equipment."^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string> .

change_assessments.reason: The removal of sh:targetClass statements from the Passenger‑instruction and Crew‑training shapes is intentional. These shapes are attached to ship instances via ex:ShipShape, so explicit targetClass declarations are unnecessary and the change aligns with the activation model defined in the requirement.
